$description:
Field contract — the RECESSED control (text inputs), the inset counterpart to
the raised control (buttons) in control.css.

A field is a control: it reuses the control SIZING ramp
(--a63-control-height/padding-inline/font-size/radius), so it inherits
design-language (iOS taller) sizing for free.

Theme-overridable hooks: --a63-field-{background,border,radius,shadow,
focus-ring,focus-border}. Only --a63-field-shadow gets a default here — it is
mode-independent (static inset), so it's safe to declare at :root and let
themes override it on their shell. The OTHER hooks resolve at the recipe
use-site against mode/theme/brand-dependent semantics (--a63-surface-control,
--a63-border-control, --a63-control-radius, --a63-focus-ring,
--a63-action-primary); declaring THOSE at :root would freeze their var()s to
the root's mode/theme and inherit the wrong value down — the
resolve-at-declaration trap. So they stay UNSET here and the recipe reads
`var(--a63-field-X, <semantic>)`: a theme override wins, else the live
semantic resolves per the field's own scope. A theme sets --a63-field-shadow
(all four) and, where it re-skins the fill, --a63-field-background (terminal).

shadow.$description: Recessed inset — mode-independent, so safe to default here.
